G IUFÀ- 'N TONI Oh! Such a misfortune, a			misfortune! As if the first one wasn't bad enough, now this second misfortune.			And then, when it rains it pours. 

T REE- B AMBÙ What misfortune are you talking about, Giufà? You seem hale and hearty, very elegant			in that cow-dung-coloured outfit with yellow sparrow's vomit touches on your			hat. 

G IUFÀ The hat was the			greenest of greens: spotless. It's just that a cow shat on me. Never mind a			sparrow or canary … a cow! 

T REE How could a cow shit			on your head, Giufà? Since the world began, cows stay flat on the ground. 

G IUFÀ It's because			I'm distressed! I'm distressed! And earlier I was even more distressed			and while I was distressed, I fell asleep near the cowshed, and with this green hat			on my head the cow mistook me for a meadow. 

T REE And is this the			misfortune that's troubling you, Giufà? 

G IUFÀ If only that were			all! A good many other painful events are troubling Giufà's soul. And they are			so troubling that I now realize to my great horror that I've gone blind. 

T REE You're not			blind, Giufà. It's just that night has fallen. 

G IUFÀ You're making			fun of me, stranger! I'm blind, I tell you! And the proof is that you're			talking to me but I can't see you. There! Giufà's logic is sharp! And			logic tells me that if you can see me the sun must be up. 

T REE It's night Giufà, believe			me. 

G IUFÀ You don't			say? It's night, is it? And how could Giufà, distressed, have slept for ten			hours? 

T REE Young man of little			faith and little intelligence. You see me and don't recognize me. I'm			Tree, and I have the power to console, like all forms of greenery and stone. I			belong to the race of those who stand and observe, not the human race, which fumes			and frets, farts and kno...
zh:
65

朱法-恩托尼：哦！何等不幸，不幸啊！仿佛第一次还不够糟，现在又来了这第二桩不幸。真是祸不单行哪。

树-班布：你说的是哪门子不幸，朱法？你看上去健壮结实，那身牛粪色的行头配你帽子上黄雀呕吐物般的点缀，可真够雅致的。

朱法：那帽子本是绿中之绿：一尘不染。只不过一头母牛拉在了我身上。别说什么麻雀金丝雀了……是一头牛！

树：母牛怎么会拉到你头上，朱法？开天辟地以来，母牛从没离开过地面。

朱法：那是因为我心烦意乱！心烦意乱啊！方才我更烦，烦着烦着就在牛棚边睡着了，戴着这顶绿帽子，母牛把我当成一片草地了。

树：这就是让你忧心的不幸吗，朱法？

朱法：要是仅此而已倒好了！还有许许多多痛苦的事折磨着朱法的心灵。折磨得如此厉害，以至于我现在惊恐地发现自己已经瞎了。

树：你没有瞎，朱法。不过是夜幕降临了。

朱法：你在取笑我，陌生人！我告诉你，我瞎了！证据就是你在跟我说话，我却看不见你。瞧！朱法的逻辑多么犀利！逻辑告诉我，既然你能看见我，太阳一定还在天上。

树：是夜晚了，朱法，相信我。

朱法：你是说？是夜晚了？心烦意乱的朱法怎么可能一觉睡了十个钟头？

树：你这缺乏信仰又缺乏智慧的小伙子啊。你看见我，却不认得我。我是树，我拥有抚慰的力量，一如一切草木与石头。我属于静立观察的族类，不属于那躁动不安、怨天尤人的人类种族……
